metadata.title: Safe and Trusted Medical Operations

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for operating network-connected medical devices in a manner that preserves patient safety, clinical trust, and regulatory compliance.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Medical devices, clinical systems, and Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) environments.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite pattern asserting that medical devices are governed, secured, and operated safely within clinical environments.

props.name: safety-principle
props.remarks: Cybersecurity controls must always support, and never compromise, patient safety or continuity of care.

metadata.remarks: Safe and Trusted Medical Operations is a composite pattern asserting that medical devices are identified, risk-classified, protected, lifecycle-managed, and operated in a manner that preserves patient safety and clinical trust. This pattern introduces no independent controls and may be claimed only when all constituent IoMT capability patterns are realized.

components.title: Medical Device Core
components.description: Definition, classification, and baseline safety assumptions for regulated medical devices.

components.title: Patient Safety Assurance
components.description: Integration of cybersecurity risk analysis with clinical hazard identification and fail-safe safety controls.

components.title: Clinical Data Protection
components.description: Protection of integrity, confidentiality, and appropriate use of clinical data generated by medical devices.

components.title: Device Lifecycle and Recall
components.description: Safety-preserving commissioning, update, recall, and decommissioning of medical devices.
